adjudication.purpose: Rank 43 new-listing exact-counterpart gate, including every sibling in the same official announcement.
adjudication.source: New exact official September 7 listing; September 4 retained metadata had both pending. Article code appears only as a related link in a different retained article; no exact article GET found.
adjudication.sequence: Retain announcement first and require both exact symbols and announced launch date. Only after that passes capture one current Polymarket instrument inventory. No prices, funding or further inventory requests.
adjudication.match_rule: Require exact underlying and share class, unit, quote and settlement mapping. Candidate base aliases restricted to BYD and HK0992; Lenovo/name-only or similar-ticker matches do not pass. An exact ticker alone is not economic equivalence. Quanto cannot inherit linear hedge semantics.
adjudication.inventory_gate: Require complete list representation and unique instrument IDs/symbols. Emit only schema, counts and selected non-economic instrument identity fields. Missing counterpart stops before funding, tickers, prices, fees or account data.
adjudication.failure: Retain all failure bytes; no refetch, aliases or reordered request sequence. Zero-network adjudication only. No accepted-edge claim.
adjudication.authority: Public read-only only. No protected partial, credentials, accounts, orders or funds.
adjudication.retry: After no-match, only material new exact counterpart listing or independently changed conversion/settlement economics; not rolling recapture.
